messages:
Maya (eng-runtime): Heads up — after today's release we're seeing a 200-400ms added tail latency on streaming responses when tool-calls are in the trace. P50 looks fine, p95/p99 up.
Liam: saw it too in canary. Repro with the replay harness?
Maya (eng-runtime): yes, ran replay on canary cluster: baseline p99 ~ 120ms, release p99 ~ 540ms. Attached perf snippet: 
```text
RPC: send_chunk -> serialize_tool_call: +170ms
kernel_select_auto: switched to 'fp16_fallback' for a lot of short-batch requests
kv_cache: miss_rate spike from 2% -> 18%
```
Sasha: that's odd — nothing in model code changed in this release. What PRs merged?
Liam: suspect two PRs merged together: #4578 framed SSE chunking change and #4591 kernel auto-select heuristic tweak. Both landed in the same deploy.
Maya (eng-runtime): bisect started — can reproduce locally with the same workload. Doing git bisect on staging images now.
InfraBot: Perf CI job failed: streaming_p99_regression (pre-merge) +28% on runner-ubuntu-22 — logs at https://ci/reports/1234
Sasha: if kernel auto-select is picking different kernels for short sequences, it could be breaking batching packing which increases serialization overhead.
Maya (eng-runtime): dug into the trace — serializer holds a mutex while building tool-call envelope. With coalesced chunks we now serialize larger envelopes under the same lock. That plus kv misses causes cascading stalls.
Liam: quick mitigation: revert kernel heuristic (PR #4591) on canary and re-run.
Maya (eng-runtime): reverted #4591 on canary — p99 dropped back to ~140ms within 2 deploys. Good candidate.
Sasha: but SSE framing change (#4578) still in. We need to ensure framing doesn't increase lock contention; maybe stream chunk boundaries need to signal earlier flush.
Maya (eng-runtime): opened an issue to decouple serialization from kv lookup — async serialize path: https://gh/reds/issue/589
Liam: plan: revert #4591 across rollout, add unit that measures kernel selection frequency, and add a streaming bench to CI that runs toolcall-heavy traces.
Sasha: also add an invariant check: when kernel decision changes, compare estimated batch packing efficiency. If below threshold, skip change.
Maya (eng-runtime): for the immediate rollback — will trigger canary -> rollback -> full rollback if green. @oncall can you keep an eye on the alert? :eyes:
oncall: watching, will page if >2x p99.
Maya (eng-runtime): logs we'll attach in PR: 
```text
pprof top (serialize_tool_call):
  42.1%  serialize_tool_call
   9.5%  kv_get (misses)
   5.2%  kernel_dispatch_wait
```
Liam: CI perf job ticketed — adding regression test to pre-merge suite.
Sasha: nice find. Once we stabilize, follow-up: tune kv eviction thresholds to reduce miss burst on streaming.
Maya (eng-runtime): summary: root cause combo: kernel auto-select + framing change -> larger serialized envelopes + lock contention + surge in kv misses -> p99 regressions. Reverted kernel auto-select; monitoring for recovery.
Liam: next steps doc: short PR to make kernel change gated behind a perf flag + add bench + add canary metric.
Maya (eng-runtime): thanks — will post status update when full rollback completes. :thumbsup:
